title: Per-agent seat arm score aggregation

claims.text: aggregate_score validates the agent/seat/arm identity, requires rows with task_id, seed, boolean correct and integer-or-null costs, checks redeliveries, then retains only the first row per task_id.

For every cost field it reports known, unknown, total and mean (None when nothing is known) and counts n_tasks, n_correct, n_incorrect, correctness (None for zero tasks) and ignored_repeats as repeated rows.
It returns the lineage.arena.score/v1 summary with sorted task_ids and a copied seat dict for the given memory_arm.

triggers: correct must be an explicitly adjudicated boolean

decision.rule: Change here when score retention, correctness ratio, or unknown cost accounting needs to change.
decision.failure: Repeated seeds double-count tasks, a boolean accepts a truthy non-boolean, or unknown costs enter arithmetic.

questions.q: Where does aggregate_score retain the first seed per task?
Where should I change how unknown costs are counted in summaries?
Where can I debug why ignored_repeats counts repeated rows?
